messages:
Ari Thompson: Hey team — Riverfront replied, ready to onboard a 9-person pilot next Mon. Main asks: simple telemetry hook, a short enablement flow, and an early-warning renewal signal.
Liam (Riverfront): Hi! We'll send 1 PM + 2 ML engineers. Prefer an afternoon kickoff. Also want a sample failure-report format.
Ari Thompson: @Sam can you take infra for this? We need: tag, minimal event schema, and a dashboard with active seats + p95 by model.
Sam Vega: Yep. I'll create tag `riverfront_pilot` and a tiny Grafana dashboard. Minimal schema below and I'll provide curl example.
Noelle Grant: I'll lead enablement — 30m goals, 50m hands-on, 10m Q&A. Planning a prompt-playbook + cost walk-through. Also will prepare a 1-page "when to involve SE" guide.
onboard-bot: Pilot intake created — docs: Ari Thompson, infra: Sam Vega, enablement: Noelle Grant, legal: intake-team.
Sam Vega: Telemetry snippet to give Riverfront:
```
curl -X POST https://telemetry.redwood.ai/v1/events \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"customer":"riverfront","user_id":"u_17","model":"redwood-tuned","tokens":312,"lat_ms":142,"event":"query"}'
```
Sam Vega: Dashboard KPIs: daily active seats, tokens/day, p95 latency, and a derived "engaged" flag (>=2 queries/day). I'll add a cost_per_1k_tokens panel.
Ari Thompson: Renewal risk note: they said renewal discussion depends on clear usage within first 10 days. Flag if active seats < 4 or avg_daily_tokens/user < 400 by day 7.
Noelle Grant: Adoption cadence: Day 1 kickoff + quick wins, Day 3 prompt clinic, Day 6 adoption push + office hours, Day 9 power-user interview, Day 11 renewal prep. I'll prepare short in-channel nudges for each touchpoint.
Liam (Riverfront): Can we get a CSV export of usage weekly? Also we'll share one failing prompt example for debugging (sanitized).
Sam Vega: I'll enable CSV export and add an anonymized sample-output collector with redaction guidelines.
Ari Thompson: Action items: Sam — telemetry + dashboard + CSV by Fri EOD. Noelle — enablement deck + nudge templates by Sat. Ari — send kickoff invite for Mon 2pm PT and attach success metrics doc.
Noelle Grant: I'll also draft a 1-paragraph escalation email template to use if adoption lags.
Liam (Riverfront): Thanks — that cadence works. We'll send attendees and sanitized sample by Thu.
Ari Thompson: Saving this thread as the source of truth for Riverfront pilot intake. Will post links here once dashboards and docs are live. :white_check_mark:
